observed: Real content rendered at 1280x900 and 390x844 exposed a genuine horizontal-overflow bug in the proof-strip rail: document.documentElement.scrollWidth (1300px) exceeded clientWidth (1265px) at desktop because .proof-rail__id applied white-space:nowrap to the entire identifier+institution string (e.g. '한국건설생활환경시험연구원(KCL), 유효기간 ~2028.11.17'), which is far longer than the type-proof's specimen measure (900px single column) and does not fit a real 5-column ~200px-wide flex cell — the 2017/2021/2022/2025 stops forced the whole page to scroll horizontally, a WCAG reflow violation invisible in the wider type-proof fixture.
changed: Narrowed white-space:nowrap to a new scoped .id-token span wrapping only the actual registration/date token (제2017-3230034-00183호, 제5181호, 제7857호, 제10-2594423호, ~2028.11.17), leaving the surrounding institution-name/date-label text on .proof-rail__id/.proof-rail__desc as normal word-break:keep-all wrappable text; added min-width:0 to .proof-rail__item for flex-shrink correctness. Re-measured: scrollWidth now equals clientWidth (1265px) at 1280x900 and (375px) at 390x844 — zero horizontal overflow at either fixed viewport, every identifier still renders as one unbroken token, and hero/eyebrow/body/inline-evidence-row/CTA DOM order is preserved at both widths.

observed: Re-proving the approved type-proof.md contract inside the real production container (after document.fonts.ready, computed via getComputedStyle) found that word-break:keep-all — required by .omd/type-proof.md for .hero-h1, .hero-body, and .h2/section headings, and confirmed necessary for '.timeline li'/'.steps li' Korean compound-noun wrapping — was present on the specimen fixture but had never been added to the actual shared production selectors .hero__title, .hero__desc, the new .section-head__title, or .process-rail__label; computed wordBreak read 'normal' on all four at both 1280px and 390px, risking mid-word breaks of compound nouns like '서울지방식품의약품안전청' or '수술용 유해가스 필터장치' the type-proof had explicitly tested and fixed only in its own wider specimen container.
changed: Added word-break: keep-all to .hero__title, .hero__desc, .section-head__title, .process-rail__label, .proof-stat__label, .teaser-card__title, and .hero__evidence (every real Korean text block newly authored or restyled for this page). Re-ran the same computed-style probe after document.fonts.ready at both 1280x900 and 390x844: family is 'Noto Sans KR' throughout, requested vs. computed weights match the approved contract exactly (h1 500, h1 strong 800, body 400, eyebrow/id-token 400, process label 700), wordBreak now reads 'keep-all' on every checked selector, and whiteSpace:nowrap is scoped correctly to only the .id-token spans (registration numbers/dates), not their surrounding institution-name text — confirmed with zero horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth===clientWidth) at 1280, 900, and 390px.
